subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw still add a public `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` contract now that current main routes completions through requester-session handoff by default, and should it exist per-spawn, as `agents.defaults.subagents`, or as part of a broader announce policy?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but adding a model-facing tool/config default changes public completion-routing semantics and overlaps open suppression, per-channel, and structured handoff issues.

options.title: Add unified announce policy
options.body: Add a default-compatible policy that covers parent routing, channel delivery, and deterministic suppression without parallel one-off controls.

options.title: Add narrow announceTarget
options.body: Add only `announceTarget` to `sessions_spawn` and optionally `agents.defaults.subagents`, leaving suppression and per-channel routing to separate issues.

options.title: Document current handoff only
options.body: Treat current requester-session handoff as enough and decline a separate public routing knob, documenting the supported default behavior instead.

recommendation.title: Add unified announce policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-compatible policy that covers parent routing, channel delivery, and deterministic suppression without parallel one-off controls.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across the spawn tool, announce delivery, and docs contract surfaces.
